text: I am kindly asking for your support in implementing up-to-date turn restrictions that will ensure there are one way traffic flows during Forest Hill Junior and Senior Public School’s (FHJSPS) morning drop-off and afternoon pick-up. In 2020, FHJSPS altered its drop-off and pick-up times to 8:30am and 2:45pm. Historically, the turn-restrictions in the school’s zone created a clockwise traffic flow by restricting two-way traffic during the school’s drop-off and pick-up times. With the passage of this motion, the turn-restrictions will again align with FHJSPS’s pick-up and drop-off times, making it safer for caretakers and schoolchildren getting to and from school.
